# Policy rules

`govpack check` runs these over the pack.

| Rule | Severity | Requirement | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GOV001` | critical | Every control has exactly one mapping, and every mapping names a control | A control without a mapping is an unexamined gap; a mapping without a control is noise. |
| `GOV002` | high | A status is backed by the evidence it requires | Implemented needs running code, tests or configuration; partial needs some evidence; designed needs a document. |
| `GOV003` | high | Anything short of implemented has an owner, a stated limit and a next step | A gap nobody owns stays a gap; a limit left unsaid becomes a false assurance. |
| `GOV004` | critical | Evidence points at a registered repository and a safe relative path | A path outside the evidence repository, or an unregistered repository, cannot be verified. |
| `GOV005` | high | Every evidence file is pinned by hash in the lock file, and the lock has nothing extra | Evidence that can change without anyone noticing is a claim, not evidence. |
| `GOV006` | high | Wording does not claim compliance or certification | A mapping shows that evidence exists; whether a system complies is a legal and audit judgement. |
| `GOV007` | medium | Control IDs are unique, references match the framework, and enumerations are valid | Stable identifiers and valid values keep reports and cross-references trustworthy. |
| `GOV008` | medium | Each mapping was reviewed recently | Repositories change; a mapping nobody has looked at for months is a guess about the present. |
| `GOV009` | high | A purely organisational control is never marked implemented by repository evidence | Training, policy approval and legal decisions are not things code can demonstrate. |
| `GOV010` | medium | Evidence says what it shows and names the text that proves it | A bare file link tells a reviewer nothing; a checked phrase catches a file that was emptied or rewritten. |
| `GOV011` | high | Systems refer only to registered repositories and existing controls | A system record that cites something that does not exist undermines the rest of the pack. |
